description: This file contains unit tests for the SecurePrefs class in an Android application, specifically testing notification forwarding and quiet hours configuration.

classes.name: SecurePrefsNotificationForwardingTest
classes.description: Test class containing multiple test methods for verifying notification quiet hours configuration and retrieval.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingQuietHours_rejectsInvalidDraftsWithoutMutatingStoredValues
methods.description: Verifies that invalid quiet hours drafts are rejected and stored values remain unchanged.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingQuietHours_persistsValidDraftsAndEnabledState
methods.description: Checks that valid quiet hours drafts are persisted and enabled state is correctly updated.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingQuietHours_disablesWithoutRevalidatingDrafts
methods.description: Ensures disabling quiet hours does not revalidate or alter previous valid drafts.

methods.name: getNotificationForwardingPolicy_readsLatestQuietHoursImmediately
methods.description: Verifies that the latest quiet hours policy is read immediately after setting.

methods.name: notificationForwarding_defaultsDisabledForSaferPosture
methods.description: Checks default values for notification forwarding are disabled for a safer posture.
